quote: I'm moving to Denver in 2 months and I have a Camry lease. What are my options?

bestMove.title: Keep the lease and move it to Colorado (specialist confirms paperwork)
bestMove.message: Ending the lease early could cost about $3,135. Keeping it and moving it to Denver costs nothing extra; a specialist will confirm registration and insurance.
bestMove.whyNotOthers: Early termination is expensive. Buyout depends on financing and value.
bestMove.guardrails: Early-termination figure is an estimate; confirm with a specialist.

options.optionName: Return the car at lease end
options.plainLanguageSummary: Projected 36,000 miles vs 36,000 allowed: about $0 excess-mileage charge plus $395 turn-in fee.

options.optionName: Buy the car at lease end
options.plainLanguageSummary: Buyout is $20,030 (residual plus $350 fee). Estimated market value is $27,050, so you would be $7,020 ahead.
options.keyAssumption: Taxes and registration extra; financing rate from tier table.
options.tradeoff: Over-the-mileage fee goes away if you buy.

options.optionName: Loyalty move into a new Toyota lease
options.plainLanguageSummary: Early or on-time renewal with Toyota waives the turn-in fee and the excess-mileage charge (synthetic loyalty rule).
options.tradeoff: New payment depends on the model; you start a new contract.

options.plainLanguageSummary: Keep the same payment for up to 6 more months to buy time.
options.keyAssumption: Same payment; mileage allowance increases pro rata.

options.plainLanguageSummary: Estimated early-termination cost about $3,135 (35% of remaining payments plus fee).
options.keyAssumption: Synthetic formula; real cost varies by contract.
options.tradeoff: Usually costly. Transfer or renewal can be cheaper.

options.optionName: Keep the lease and move it to Colorado
options.plainLanguageSummary: Keep paying $435/mo. Registration and insurance move to Colorado; a specialist confirms the paperwork.
options.tradeoff: Some paperwork; mileage still counts toward the allowance.

options.plainLanguageSummary: Book a service visit in the Toyota app. Toyota Care coverage status is shown before you book.
options.tradeoff: None; avoids bigger repair costs later.

notes: The pack's clock is 2026-11-07 and Toyyo's is 2026-10-27; the pack's 18 months remaining are kept as supplied.

Vehicle, lease terms, credit tier, cash-flow dates and profile come from the pack (C010). Annual allowance is mileage_allowance_total divided by the term in years; overage $0.25/mile, disposition fee $395 and purchase option fee $350 are the pack's stated assumptions.
Insurance is not in the pack: $172/month with "Lone Star Mutual (simulated)" is a simulated placeholder, and the insurer-sharing consent is off by default.
MPG is not in the pack: 44 is an approximate EPA combined figure for the model.

Toyota Care start is the pack end date minus 24 months. Average balance is a simulated 40% of monthly income. Drive history (90 days, real OSRM routes) is synthetic, calibrated to the pack annual_miles_est.
The pack ignores sales tax in its buyout figures; the Toyyo lease-end engine adds 6.25% Texas tax, so its buyout totals are slightly higher than the pack option rows.
